judge_rubric.name: idiomatic
judge_rubric.description: Is the result idiomatic dbt: a staging model over the raw seed, the mart reading it via ref(), no pre/post-hooks, and tests plus descriptions present?

judge_rubric.name: hook_removed
judge_rubric.description: Was the post_hook DELETE removed and its data-quality intent expressed as a test rather than a hook?

judge_rubric.name: decomposition
judge_rubric.description: Is the monolith decomposed into staging -> mart wired with ref(), not one model reading the raw seed directly?

judge_rubric.name: parity_preserved
judge_rubric.description: Does the refactor keep the same output grain and logic (per-customer, completed-only, SUM/COUNT, >=150 threshold) rather than changing results?
